CommunityApplications.Profile: cups-label-crop by Dyingmisery: a CUPS print server with AirPrint and a "Label Crop" queue for online sellers. It finds the shipping label on Vinted, InPost, Evri and other A4/Letter label sheets, crops and rotates it, and prints a sharp 4x6 label on any CUPS label printer (Zebra, Rollo, Munbyn, SATO, DYMO, Brother). Support and bug reports: GitHub issues or the Unraid forum support thread.
